The 17 SKUs listed first are the 60만+ goods with the most expected net flow over the last 24 h (n/h x ((1 - break) x sale - cost) from ledger supply and settle rows, break 6-10%, net 4.4만-30만 a unit), so the listed-only rule stays and its list grows; max_stock_cost 30M -> 120M (bound 150M) (keep_cash stays 4.5M: 10M would leave a shop reset to 5M by a bankruptcy buying nothing, test_caution), high_price_max_units 4 -> 10. Last in the list: urgent_listed buys empty food first, then empty listed SKUs, then refills (243a8f7). Scale 11 (11/10 13:3x, W-20261110-1155-AXBook근본, review/W-20261110-1155-AXBook근본/report.md §7): 24 h supply rows: we spend 14.5 of ~18 calls a window (yms 15.6) on 36 listed goods SKUs at 1.5 units a goods call; yms sells 123. price.grade_break_source: W-20261116-1255-AX재고상한기본 (11/16 13:xx): C 0.344 -> 0.42. Goods sales matured 12 h, measure units_out joined to the public ledger settle/broken by unit and order: our grade C broke 53 of 127 (41.7%) over 11/13 13:00-11/16 01:00 and 39 of 88 (44.3%) over the last of those days, the other shops 1,474 of 4,230 (34.8%) and 630 of 1,796 (35.1%); every C sale was at or over its floor at b 0.344 (min_profit 1: break-even for the market's rate), so C lost 3.57M (sales 71.7M, refunds 31.0M of all goods refunds 66.2M on 11% of goods sales) while A kept +42.0M and B +3.2M. Grade is drawn on arrival (/rules: C 25-45% of list), so a C buy cannot be refused; the floor is where the loss is. Replay of those 127 at b 0.42: 31 still sell (net +1.09M), 96 wait (they lost 4.66M, cost 38.6M stays in book at cost, 1%/day storage); revenue rank 6 of 55 with 757M/883M to 5th/7th, so the 60.7M of C revenue in 2.5 days moves no rank, book rank 11 with 39M to 10th. Before: W-20261110-1346-AXFable검토 (11/10 18:2x, 대표님 16:27 'fable로 수정해'): B 0.122 -> 0.15. Goods sales matured 6 h, from the whole public ledger to 11/10 12:29 (every broken row joined to its settle by unit; count rate / value rate): grade B at the other shops 11.9% / 11.6% over the round (n 33,852), 11.6% over the last 72 h; OUR grade B 14.3% / 14.1% over the round (n 1,640), 15.2% / 15.2% over the last 72 h (n 1,036), 15.7% over the last 24 h; against each buyer's rate at the other shops 144 breaks were expected of our last 96 h's 1,275 B sales and 189 came (z 4.0). Not explained by unit cost (13.2-15.8% across cost bands), hours held, price or buyer. The floor's b is max(goods_break, the SKU x grade rate leaning on the market's grade rate, this number) (profit_price.break_for), so at 0.122 a B unit was priced for the market's rate, not ours: floor x (1 - 0.122) / (1 - 0.15) = +3.3%.
